curated_conditions.condition_label: RIB40 | grown on rice | time and temperature not stated
curated_conditions.production_context: A. oryzae vs A. flavus comparison on rice
curated_conditions.metadata_source: BioProject PRJNA164609 (SRA study SRP012984, Vanderbilt University, title 'Aspergillus oryzae Transcriptome or Gene expression'): 'Comparative gene expression to A. flavus while grown on rice. 3 isolates: RIB 40, RIB 632, RIB 642.' SRA library Lib 1 ('A. oryzae RIB 40 sample', BioSample SAMN00992181, Illumina HiSeq 2000). The record gives no rice preparation, temperature or time, and no accession-linked paper was found. The same three isolates were also sequenced on potato dextrose agar in PRJNA178638.
